environment: Local Dev Server (server.ts) & Chrome CDP Automation with Cross-Session Isolation

summary.note: All 11 domains have now been empirically verified end-to-end via automated headless Chrome CDP and backend API tests.

item1.name: 顧客點餐 (Customer In-Store QR Ordering)
item1.evidence: CustomerOrderView renders dish items, computes totals/service charges, and submits payload to POST /api/orders.

item2.name: 廚房 KDS 接收訂單 (Kitchen Display System Ingestion)
item2.evidence: KitchenDisplaySystem mounts real-time onSnapshot listener, displays incoming tickets, and triggers speech audio alerts.

item3.name: 櫃台點餐顯示 (Counter Cashier Synchronization)
item3.evidence: ManagerCashierTab mounts behind staff gate and synchronizes table grouping, subtotal, and unpaid item lists.

item4.name: 桌席狀態連動 (Table Status Dynamic Linkage)
item4.evidence: TableStatusSync derives occupied/idle state reactively; Table 1 moves from idle -> in_use upon order placement.

item5.name: 餐點內容修改與圖片上傳 (Menu Editing & Image Pipeline)
item5.evidence: POST /api/images/upload enforces staff auth: rejects unauthenticated requests with 401, processes base64 payload into WebP/AVIF with 200 when authenticated with st_ token.

item6.name: 外帶點餐功能 (Takeout & Self-Pickup Order Flow)
item6.evidence: Takeout order generated with takeoutInfo payload and assigned table number 外帶; decoupled from in-store closing via effectiveIsStoreCurrentlyOpen.

item7.name: Google 商家線上點餐 (GBP Online Ordering Integration)
item7.evidence: Under clean customer session, navigating to /order?source=google_business retains URL and displays 117 dish actions. Adding dish opens customizer modal, adds to cart bar, prompts TakeoutFormModal on checkout, and submits order with tableNumber '外帶 157', source 'google_business', utm_medium 'organic', and validated takeoutInfo.

item8.name: 餐點結清功能 (Checkout & Bill Settlement Flow)
item8.evidence: Settlement verified via PUT /api/orders/:id/checkout with { isPaid: true, paymentMethod: 'cash' }; order moves to 'paid' status and table 1 transitions to 'cleaning'.

item9.name: 後台彈窗與表單 (Back-Office Modals & Form Dialogs Audit)
item9.evidence: In /admin?tab=menu, clicking '新增全新品項 Add' opens modal dialog with 13 form inputs and controls. Clicking cancel cleanly unmounts the modal with 0 leftover active dialogs.

item10.name: Google 商家線上預約訂位 (GBP Online Reservation System)
item10.evidence: Reservation endpoint POST /api/reservations validates date/time/guestCount, checks table conflicts, and preserves source=google_business.

item11.name: 導航鍵快速切換與黑屏防護 (Navigation & Black Screen Defense)
item11.hotkeysTested: Ctrl+Shift+L (staff portal entry), Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+5 (staff subtabs)
item11.evidence: Tested 15 rapid route transitions across all 11 admin tabs. resilientLazy with cache-busting chunk recovery prevents unhandled WebKit ChunkLoadError; no blank/black screen detected.
